```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
get_ps_assigned <- function(N){
    read_csv("key_dates.csv") |> 
        filter(Item == "Homework", 
               Number == N, 
               str_detect(Details, "Released")) |>
        pull(Date) |>
        format("%A %B %d")
}

get_ps_due <- function(N){
    read_csv("key_dates.csv") |> 
        filter(Item == "Homework", 
               Number == N, 
               str_detect(Details, "Due")) |>
        pull(Date) |>
        format("%A %B %d at 5:00PM on Gradescope")
}

get_ps_link <- function(N){
    sprintf("[Problem Set #%02g](./problem_sets/ps%02g.qmd)", N, N)
}

N <- 0
```


## Problem Sets


### Problem Set #0`r (N <- N+1)`

- Assigned: `r get_ps_assigned(N)`
- Due: `r get_ps_due(N)`

Link: `r get_ps_link(N)`
